title: IRON FAUNA
about: Capture unusual creatures, graft them into battle companions, and ride them against the factories that turned life into machinery.

controls.desc: Visible touch controls move through the overworld; WASD / arrows are optional shortcuts
Visible touch buttons talk, enter doors, and advance dialogue; Space / Enter are optional shortcuts
Visible battle buttons open the order panel, choose commands, target parts, hop, and set orders
Visible battle control pauses or resumes the clock; P is an optional shortcut
Visible overworld navigation buttons return to the menu or open the Codex
Visible outcome button acknowledges the battle result
